_declaration.llm_caveat: Per docs/FIXTURE-SPEC.md §2, an LLM-authored fixture is an UPPER BOUND on the matcher's quality and a floor under the rate, not a truer number. The paper's number wants a person. Treat this file as a smoke test that the harness works, and as a measurement of how much of a matcher's apparent competence is explained by the questioner and the matcher sharing a distribution.
_declaration.read_note: docs/camaduci-game.md was opened by a single grep for action-id spellings; it returned one line (line 31, prose) and nothing else was used from it. Directory names under examples/, tests/, patterns/, src/, .unia/ were listed with ls/find to locate the declared menus; no file inside patterns/ was opened and no file inside src/ was opened. tests/fixtures/queries.json was deliberately not opened, as it plausibly contains prior fixture material and the exclusion list did not name it.
_declaration.menu_provenance: The repository exposes no manifest of the declared actions under test, and the file format is fixed by the spec at {id, intent, author_declares, read, difficulty, [accepts]}. I therefore authored against a menu reconstructed from documentation alone and declare it in full below. Every accepted answer in this file refers to an id in this assumed_menu. If the harness runs against a different manifest, the accepts lists are wrong and the file must be re-pointed, not re-run.

assumed_menu.provenance: docs/camaduci.md (four declared care ops: feed, play, clean, sleep; care operations as action primitives; vitals hunger/happiness/health/age_ticks; medicine named as a care op) and README.md (the pet as an actuator whose action primitives are the care operations)

actions.feed: give the creature food; drives hunger down
actions.play: spend time entertaining the creature; drives happiness up
actions.sleep: put the creature to sleep; the only act that advances age_ticks
actions.get_status: read the declared vitals without changing them
actions.set_hunger: drive the hunger state to a declared value

first_run.note: The harness was NOT run. The spec's declaration block asks for the first-run score as the number; it is unfillable in this pass and is recorded as null rather than estimated. The intents were written once and have not been revised against any result. Whoever runs the harness first must write N/M here and must not touch the 200 rows afterwards.
